title: Scorpion letters S1 and S5, 1991 (Schmeh Top 50 no. 12)

documents.shelfmark: Letter to John Walsh, 1991 (scan via Oranchak / Cipherbrain)

plaintext.source: Claimed readings (Farmer 2007, Roberts 2016, Rubislaw32 2018) are unverified.

transcription.notes: Filled-square and half-circle glyph families uncertain.

documents.shelfmark: Letter to John Walsh, 1991 ('Hi! Remember me?')

transcription.source: Numeric transcription from forum.zodiackillerciphers.com thread 'Scorpion = Zodiac?'

system.summary: Symbol substitution; S5 behaves like 16 alphabets in strict rotation, S1 weakly like five.
system.notes: Every S5 repeat lies at a multiple of 16; S1 period-5 evidence is weak (P = 0.036). Types are hypotheses, not established.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: S1 transcribed from the Cipherbrain scan; S5 taken from the forum's numeric transcription.
Repeat distances: S5 period 16; S1 weak period 5.
Unicity: key information exceeds text redundancy for both (ratios 1.11, 1.18).
Random homophonic keys of the same sizes attacked with the 5-gram annealer: fluent false solutions, 3-13 % letters right.
The 2018 claimed solution tested for key consistency and English score; no better than alternatives.

outcome.method_basis: S1 was transcribed here from the Cipherbrain scan and S5 taken from the forum's numeric transcription; S5 behaves as 16 rotating alphabets and both are below the unicity distance, so no reading was reached.
outcome.notes: Below unicity distance from the published material; S2-S4 would be needed.
